description: He wears a cream long tunic with a narrow decorated standing neckline under a dark brown patterned ankle-length outer robe. Gold-toned geometric and arabesque woven borders edge the robe opening, broad sleeve cuffs and hem. Paired small round clasps link across the upper chest. A wide richly patterned gold-and-brown sash wraps the waist with a long fringed tail draped at the front. Cream inner trousers or lower robe layers and dark brown embroidered leather shoes show below the hem. Fabrics appear fine, substantial and opaque; exact fibers are uncertain. The ensemble covers torso and limbs completely and has no headgear, armor or weapons.
